text:
maria: quick heads up — noticed workspace IDs are appearing in Console telemetry (User events) raw payloads, not just internal logs. :eyes:
jon: hmm that's bad. repro steps?
maria: open console -> Debug -> Events -> click any event -> payload shows `X-Workspace-ID: ws_abc123` in the attributes field.
ashok: is that from the frontend or the backend pipeline?
maria: backend — looks like the telemetry-ingest service is copying all request headers into event.metadata. I can paste a snippet.
maria: ```json
{"event":"route_click","metadata":{"user":"sofia","X-Workspace-ID":"ws_abc123","client_ip":"1.2.3.4"}}
```
sofia: oof, that means customers' tenant ids are being stored in our analytics index. regulatory no-no.
kevin: sounds like yesterday's middleware change that flattened headers into metadata (PR #2147). cc @jon who merged. :facepalm:  
jon: yep I merged it to unblock telemetry batching. I thought headers were scrubbed by the ingress lambda. apparently not for internal console routes.
ashok: quick mitigation: mask workspace id at ingest before writing to ES and rotate access to the analytics slices. We should also backfill delete for the last 6 hrs.
maria: can we patch the service with a header blacklist now? e.g. strip `X-Workspace-ID`, `X-Org-ID` before `serializeEvent()` 
jon: doing a hotfix patch now, pushing `ingest-service@fix/scrub-headers`. deploy-bot: started deploy of ingest-service to prod (hash c3f9d1).
ashok: while we patch, let's add a server-side redact rule so any header matching `/workspace|org/i` gets replaced with `REDACTED`. That prevents similar surprises.
sofia: agree. and check dashboard tiles that show per-workspace metrics — those could be inaccurate if we mixed tenant ids.
kevin: good catch. Also audit the queries in `console-telemetry` Kibana to see which saved searches include `metadata.X-Workspace-ID` and remove them.
maria: I pulled index list — last write with `X-Workspace-ID` was at 1987654405.
sre-bot: alert acknowledged: incident created #INC-2026 "Telemetry header exposure" assigned to eng-platform.
jon: hotfix is live on ingest-service canary (1987654410). Rolling to prod now.
maria: after canary validates, please trigger a short retention purge job on `telemetry-events-*` for docs containing `X-Workspace-ID`. We'll coordinate with privacy.
kevin: I'll take ownership of the purge. planning window in 30m.
ashok: longer term: we need a policy in our SDKs that forbids shipping tenant-identifying headers into analytics. Add lint rule and unit test.
sofia: and update runbook for telemetry onboarding: explicitly call out header scrub.
jon: timeline: hotfix -> 10m canary -> prod -> purge job -> postmortem. I'll post updates here.
maria: thanks — please ping if anything else shows up. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy of ingest-service (c3f9d1) to prod succeeded at 1987654418.
sre-bot: purge job scheduled by kevin at 1987654420 (window 30m).
